title: All-in-One Multi-Industry Edition • Complete Indian Festival Calendar & 60-FPS Motion-Video Top Strip
highlights: Complete 60-FPS Motion-Video Festival Calendar: Added dedicated vector motion scenes for Ramzan (Crescent Moon, Mosque silhouette & swaying Fanoos lanterns), Vinayagar Chaturthi (Golden Crown & Trunk mandala + steaming Modakams on banana leaves), Ayudha Pooja (Mango-leaf & Marigold Toran + flickering Kuthuvilakku lamps), Independence Day & Republic Day (3D waving Indian Tricolor Flag, rotating 24-spoke Ashoka Chakra & soaring peace doves), New Year, Tamil New Year, Deepavali, Pongal, Christmas, and Owner Birthday.

Smart 2-Day Pre-Festival Top Strip & 3-Day Pongal Celebration: Top strip animation starts 2 days before Diwali, Pongal, Christmas, and Ramzan (and runs across all 3 Pongal days Jan 14–16), while the Greeting Popup appears strictly once on the actual festival day.

Plan-Specific VIP License Activation Celebration: Animated Golden Confetti, Sparkles & VIP Certificate strictly for the customer's activated plan tier (1 Year, 3 Years Offer, or Lifetime + Android App).
First-Install Shop Owner Birthday Collection & 1-Click Customer Birthday WhatsApp Wishes.
3-Tier Subscription Plans: 1 Year (₹1,500), 3 Years Offer (₹3,000), and Lifetime + Android App Combo (₹9,000).
fixes: Separated 2-day pre-festival top-strip animation window from exact-day first-open Greeting Popup.
Replaced flat emoji symbols in the top animation strip with articulated 60-FPS custom vector motion-graphics scenes with zero text clutter.
Prevented Free Plan monthly quota reset when deleting Invoices, Quotations, Job Sheets, or Products.
